title: astragalus pygmaeus
intro: Astragalus pygmaeus, commonly known as Dwarf Milkvetch, is a perennial plant species belonging to the legume family. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to boost the immune system, reduce inflammation, and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus pygmaeus include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and adaptogenic properties, which contribute to its potential in treating conditions such as diabetes, cancer, and respiratory diseases. The bioactive constituents of Astragalus pygmaeus include flavonoids, saponins, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
